data.title: After More Than a Decade of Empowering Women and Girls, I Choose To Win Announces Planned Dissolution
data.description: Fort Washington, Pennsylvania - On August 7th, 2026, a Philadelphia-based nonprofit organization called I Choose To Win (ICTW) revealed its decision to disband after operating for 11 years. Throughout its tenure, ICTW has supported over 10,000 women and girls by providing education, empowerment, and essential skills for success. The organization's dissolution is set to take effect on September 30th, 2026.

data.title: Cosign Launches in Fargo as Rental Vacancies Continue to Climb
data.description: A platform known as Cosign, functioning as a third-party lease guarantor, is playing a pivotal role in Fargo, North Dakota's tight rental market. This platform aims to enhance the likelihood of apartment approvals by offering an alternative for co-signers. The initiative is making waves as it provides increased rental opportunities for tenants while ensuring the protection of property owners. This development comes as a crucial support in the competitive rental landscape of Fargo. The positive impact is reflected in the notable surge in apartment approvals, marking a significant increase and addressing the challenges faced by tenants in securing accommodation in this demanding rental market.

data.title: Cosign Launches in Columbus as New Supply Pushes Apartment Vacancy to a Record High
data.description: A third-party guarantor platform based in Columbus, Ohio, known as Cosign, has introduced an innovative cosigner alternative to help approve a greater number of qualified renters across the Columbus Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA). The platform aims to increase renter access and approval rates by providing a reliable alternative to traditional cosigners. This initiative was launched on August 7, 2026, with the intention of supporting more individuals seeking rental accommodations in the area.

data.title: Following FBI and EPA warnings, Invicti offers complimentary AppSec support to U.S. water utilities
data.description: Water utilities meeting certain criteria are eligible to receive a no-cost three-month subscription to the Invicti AppSec Platform, aimed at mitigating risks within web applications and APIs. This initiative comes in response to alerts from the FBI and EPA regarding potential cyber threats targeted at internet-connected systems. The offer, announced on August 7, 2026, in Austin, Texas, provides qualifying organizations with a valuable tool to enhance their cybersecurity efforts during a time of heightened concern.

data.title: Collette Health and VirtuAlly Partner to Deliver Virtual Care for Health Systems
data.description: A healthcare company based in Noblesville, Indiana, Collette Health, enhances its team with award-winning virtual care technology and skilled virtual nurses to support bedside staff, increase accessibility, and alleviate workforce challenges. The company, recognized twice as the Best in KLAS for Virtual Sitting and Virtual Nursing, aims to provide quality care and support for patients. The initiative, launched on August 7, 2026, aligns with the company's commitment to innovation and improving healthcare services, offering a solution to address the growing demands in healthcare.

data.title: OTB Boots Launches the Reengineered T-KOOL 2.0, Expanding Its Lineup of Tactical Footwear
